title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Residential Property Paralegal - Farnham

Farnham Competitive Salary + Benefits Full-time, Permanent

Ready to build your career in law?

Our client is a well-established law firm looking for an ambitious and motivated Residential Property Paralegal to join its busy conveyancing team. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your legal skills, gain hands-on experience and build a strong foundation for a long-term career in property law.

The Role

Working alongside experienced conveyancing solicitors, you'll gain exposure to the full property transaction process, with responsibilities including:
- Opening files and completing compliance checks
- Preparing contract packs and completion documentation
- Drafting Certificates of Title and carrying out property searches
- Preparing SDLT returns and Land Registry applications
- Resolving Land Registry requisitions
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders and solicitors

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in residential conveyancing as a paralegal or legal assistant is essential
- A law degree or ambition to progress within the legal profession would be advantageous
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Confident communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach
- Enthusiasm to learn, take on responsibility and develop your expertise

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary and benefits
- Supportive team with experienced solicitors to learn from
- Hands-on experience and opportunities to develop your career
- A professional environment where you can build your knowledge and confidence

Ready for your next step? Contact Gayle Woolf at G2 Legal or send your CV to find out more.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Our client is a well-established organisation seeking a Legal Assistant to join their team. The successful candidate will provide administrative and file management support across a range of transactions while working within a supportive and collaborative team environment.

Experience and Skills Requirements

- Exposure to legal, financial services or professional services environments.
- Knowledge of compliance processes such as AML or KYC would be advantageous.
- Strong IT skills, including experience with Microsoft Office and database/case management systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and high levels of accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to provide excellent customer service and build professional relationships with clients.
- Proactive and organised approach to work.
- Ability to manage workloads effectively, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
- Genuine interest in pursuing a career within the legal sector.
- Reliable attendance and professional attitude.
